identity: Manufacturer-hosted LM13700 single-amplifier macromodel; LM13700M/NOPB is the selected SOIC-16 device. The model does not distinguish order suffixes.
limitations: File warns that its single-pole model overestimates AC bandwidth and phase margin by more than twofold.
One amplifier is modeled; simulated supply current is half a full dual device.
No validation of actual board, package parasitics, production spread, or rail startup.
retention: Model header explicitly permits copying/distribution, prohibits resale; header retained unchanged.
